This development follows Iran's earlier announcement regarding another US military drone capture.

author: SAURABH SINHA
description: On Sunday, an IndiGo Airbus A321 operating flight 6E 6542 experienced a tail strike during a go-around. The incident occurred while attempting to land in gusty weather at Bengaluru airport. All passengers and crew were safely disembarked, and the aircraft is undergoing maintenance checks. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation is investigating the incident and has engaged with IndiGo regarding pilot training enhancements.
title: IndiGo A321 enroute Blr suffers tail strike; plane lands safely in second attempt

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Shohei Ohtani’s $700 million contract with the Los Angeles Dodgers sounds like a blockbuster headline figure, but the deal is far more unusual than that. The deal shifted the Dodgers' payroll strategy with $680 million deferred until 2034-43, and Ohtani's commercial appeal drew major attention in Japan and around the world. The deal also helped to change how massive player contracts can be structured by MLB teams.
title: Shohei Ohtani’s $700 million Dodgers contract and what it means for MLB

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Jason Kelce has made a savvy equity investment in Hank Sauce via Winnie Capital, marking a significant step for both him and the brand. Once a local staple, Hank Sauce now boasts distribution in over 5,000 stores across the country. With a U.S. hot sauce market worth nearly $2.9 billion, this partnership looks to amplify Hank Sauce's visibility and reach nationally, taking advantage of the substantial growth opportunities ahead.
title: Jason and Kylie Kelce’s investment reaches 5,000 stores in $2.9 billion move

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: In Nepal, heavy rainfall has caused devastating floods and landslides, resulting in 21 lives lost and extensive damage. Authorities have evacuated around 3,000 residents from perilous areas to guarantee their safety. This deluge follows the earlier Bhotekoshi floods, which had a death toll of over 1,400. As rescue efforts continue, landslides have disrupted operations in several districts, and tourists in vulnerable areas are being advised to take precautions.
title: Nepal battered by severe rain: 21 dead, 5 missing as floods, landslides worsen

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Yellowstone rangers removed more than 20,100 pieces of trash from geothermal areas in 2026, along with over 5,000 rocks and sticks and 280 visitor hats. Staff also collected coins worth more than $18. Among the unusual finds were AirPods, golf tees, an inhaler, Invisalign retainers, fake nails and children’s toys.
title: Yellowstone rangers pulled 20,100 items from geysers, including 280 hats

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Charles P. Baker III, who died at 101, co-founded Baker Industries with his wife Louise in 1980 after their son struggled to find suitable work. What began as a two-person garage business grew into a workforce development nonprofit that has hired, trained and mentored more than 12,500 people who faced barriers to employment.
title: 1980 garage business for son's job now helped 12,500 people

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Virat Kohli became only the second batter after Sachin Tendulkar to complete 15,000 ODI runs. He also hit his record-extending 55th ODI century as India beat West Indies by eight wickets in the first ODI. Kohli said his priority has always been to understand the situation and do what the team needs.
title: 'I promised myself': Virat Kohli after 15,000-run landmark

author: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI
description: Ashutosh Ranka, co-convenor of the Cockroach Janta Party, reported his detention by Assam Police has ended. He stated that he will address the media after being taken back to the original pick-up location. Several other CJP leaders were also detained in Guwahati before a regional volunteers' meeting near the Assam Secretariat. Police prevented access to the meeting site, which aimed to gather around 200-300 volunteers from the region.
title: ‘Illegal detention by Assam Police has finally ended’: CJP’s Ranka to address press

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: Three individuals lost their lives while four others sustained injuries in a shooting at a Detroit strip club. The confrontation, which occurred early on Sunday morning, stemmed from an argument between several patrons. Detroit Police Chief Todd Bettison confirmed that the three deceased victims were all men. Authorities are actively investigating the case and have received multiple complaints about the venue this year.
title: 3 killed, 4 injured after fight erupts into gunfire at Detroit strip club in US

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
title: Proposed bank strike deferred after talks between bank body and unions

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: The Cockroach Janta Party is gearing up for a protest in Mumbai after being denied police permission. Founder Abhijeet Dipke announced plans for a Jail Bharo Andolan on Gandhi Jayanti. This announcement follows reports of CJP co-convener Ashutosh Ranka and volunteers facing detention in Assam. NCP (SP) spokesperson Anish Gawande condemned the detentions, labeling them illegal and unconstitutional. The CJP remains dedicated to advocating for social issues despite these setbacks.
title: CJP says Mumbai Police denied Oct 2 protest permission, launches 'Jail Bharo Andolan'

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Rory McIlroy’s wealth has come from far more than PGA Tour prize money. The Northern Irish golfer has surpassed $100 million in official PGA Tour earnings, and major championship wins, bonuses, international success, sponsorships and business ventures have added to his financial portfolio. His Masters win in 2026 added $4.5 million to his already robust career earnings.
title: Rory McIlroy’s $100 million PGA Tour earnings: How he built his fortune

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Sidney Crosby’s story is about much more than his NHL salary. The captain of the Pittsburgh Penguins has made more than $150 million in reported contract value over the course of his career, while also building a commercial profile through major brand partnerships. His current contract, long-term endorsements, shareholder position with NORQAIN and property holdings give a wider view of how the hockey icon built his fortune.

description: Rob Lowe has revealed he was “the only person happy” when Will Smith slapped Chris Rock at the 2022 Oscars, hoping the shocking incident would overshadow his infamous 1989 Academy Awards performance. title: Rob Lowe says he was happy after Will Smith slapped Chris Rock at Oscars

description: After losing his job, Brian Schwartz founded a remarkable volunteer initiative named I Want To Mow Your Lawn. This program offers complimentary lawn care services to seniors, veterans, and others in need. Through a digital platform, volunteers across all 50 states now connect with those requiring assistance, resulting in a thriving community of over 2,000 compassionate participants who collectively enhance the spirit of service and support nationwide.

title: Virat Kohli breaks Sachin Tendulkar's record for most ODI centuries against a team

author: TNN
description: Students at Lovely Professional University protested against unverified claims of a rape on campus, leading to unrest. The protest intensified as students blocked the Jalandhar-Phagwara National Highway, causing significant traffic disruption. Police attempted to resolve the situation but were met with stone-pelting from protesters, resulting in injuries on both sides.

description: Delhi Police has received a complaint regarding an alleged incident involving Minister Parvesh Verma. The complaint states that Verma slapped a man during a road inspection in Tilak Nagar. AAP leader Jarnail Singh was present and questioned the quality of the road when the incident occurred. Verma disputes the allegations, claiming the video does not show the full context.

author: TYSION PRABHU
description: In Coimbatore district, Kovilpalayam police engaged in a thrilling 40km chase after suspected smugglers failed to heed police signals. Remarkably, a daring officer climbed onto the suspects' vehicle during the pursuit, making it a high-stakes operation. The pursuit came to an end when the police successfully intercepted the fleeing car, leading to the suspects' arrest. However, details about the smuggling operation are still scarce.

author: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA
description: Get ready, Atlanta! Two charming giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, will be gracing the zoo with their presence this Monday, thanks to a decade-long conservation agreement. This unique event reflects the tradition of panda diplomacy, which has played a pivotal role in fostering international friendships. The nuances of this approach reveal essential lessons in both diplomacy and environmental conservation.
title: Panda-monium: When diplomacy goes to the dogs, horses, and elephants

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: Highlighting the parallels between resilience and heroism, the Iranian Embassy in Hyderabad unveiled a video featuring President Masoud Pezeshkian's UNGA address likened to the epic tale of Baahubali. The embassy conveyed Iran's steadfastness against external pressures, as exemplified in Dr. Pezeshkian's rejection of U.S. sanctions. He asserted Iran's commitment to dialogue while maintaining a robust defense posture, amidst escalating U.S.-Iran tensions.

This move underlines the increasing demand for luxury real estate in Palm Beach.

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India showcased a stellar performance at the Asian Games 2026, clinching a total of seven medals, predominantly in athletics and squash. Parul Chaudhary shone brightly, securing a bronze in the women’s 3000m steeplechase. Silver medals were added by Ancy Sojan and Sarvesh Kushare in their respective disciplines. The boxing team also excelled, confirming three medals through successful semifinal performances.

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India added seven medals on Day 8 of the Asian Games, including two silver medals in squash and five in athletics. Parul Chaudhary achieved a new national record in the women's 3000m steeplechase, winning bronze. However, India did not win any gold medals, leading to a drop in its overall standings. Boxers Parveen Hooda, Ankush Panghal, and Narender secured medals by reaching the semifinals.

French official Jean-Noel Barrot emphasized that France's role is strictly defensive and does not equate to participation in the conflict.

description: In an impressive display of athleticism, Tejaswin Shankar clinched the decathlon bronze medal at the Asian Games by triumphing in the 1500m race. With a remarkable total of 7,934 points, he secured a podium position, while Japan's Yuma Maruyama took the gold. Meanwhile, Ancy Sojan finished just shy of gold in the women's long jump, placing second behind China's Yingying Huang.

description: India secured a memorable double podium at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand. Savitha Shri’s resilient 83-move draw sealed bronze for the women, while Arjun Erigaisi’s dramatic late victory helped the open team win silver on tiebreak. Uzbekistan took open gold and China won women’s gold. India also claimed the Gaprindashvili Cup for the best combined performance.

With $3.8 million in matching contributions, the conservation work will have a total impact of $17.1 million. The projects will restore habitat, improve migration corridors and modify 225 miles of fencing for wildlife.

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: Responding to the alarming issue of exam paper leaks, the National Testing Agency has fortified its security protocols. A dedicated team of 29 CISF personnel is now assigned to the agency's new office for rigorous oversight. In addition to advancing cybersecurity measures, the NTA is revisiting its entire examination-cycle systems to thwart unauthorized access. Independent audits will also be conducted, aiming for a significant improvement in examination integrity moving forward.

description: During a recent road inspection in Tilak Nagar, Delhi's PWD Minister Parvesh Verma faced backlash after a video emerged of him allegedly slapping a local youth. Verma stated that he acted in response to an insult aimed at his family from the youth's associate. Additionally, he accused local MLA Jarnail Singh of trying to extract commissions from roadwork contracts. Following the incident, Verma's engineer has filed an FIR.

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The Delhi High Court has taken a firm stance by ruling against a man who married a 16-year-old under Muslim personal law, emphasizing that this does not exempt him from POCSO charges concerning sexual activity. While the girl asserted her consent, the court reiterated the importance of legal safeguards for minors. Attempts to contest the FIR based on her claims were rejected, underscoring the inviolability of child protection laws.

description: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India has unveiled enhancements to prepaid mobile recharge options, featuring more voice-and-SMS-only Special Tariff Vouchers. Users can now access plans with a validity of 30 days or less. This initiative is especially beneficial for senior citizens and budget-conscious individuals who prefer voice-only prepaid plans without data, addressing concerns raised by Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha.

description: Several men were arrested near RAF Fairford on suspicion of violations under the Explosives Act. Residents of the nearby village of Whelford were evacuated to a leisure center in Cirencester. Police established a cordon around the area while an Army explosive ordnance disposal team assessed several vehicles. Counter-terrorism police are leading the investigation but have not confirmed a link to RAF Fairford.

After receiving court approval to visit her, he finally said goodbye just before her passing. Although the Supreme Court has dismissed the criminal charges against him, citing no wrongdoing, the emotional toll of his mother's death and the precious time lost lingers heavily on his heart.

description: Aurora, Colorado's 80019 ZIP code is now the most popular destination for movers in the United States. The ranking is based on a significant number of new housing developments in the area. Fort Leavenworth, Kansas, remains in second place due to military relocations that dominate its movement figures. Florida has three spots in the top ten, appealing to retirees and remote workers.
title: New homes, new jobs: Why this Denver-area ZIP code is drawing movers

description: Former footballer Thierry Henry has listed his SoHo penthouse in New York for $25 million. Henry bought the penthouse and the unit below for $14.85 million in 2010 and combined them into a roughly 6,000-square-foot home. He and his partner Andrea Rajacic renovated the property several times, including again in 2026.

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The Tamil Nadu government faced backlash after it issued a notification that exempted the Public (Law and Order) Department from the Right to Information (RTI) Act. Critics, including numerous political leaders, argued that such an action would jeopardize transparency and obstruct public access to crucial law records. In response to widespread criticism, the government promptly withdrew the exemption, reaffirming its commitment to uphold the RTI Act.

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: The UK government plans to launch a new scheme called 'Your First Home' to assist first-time buyers. This initiative allows qualifying individuals to acquire new-build properties with a minimal deposit of 2.5 percent. Eligible buyers will also receive a government equity loan for up to 20 percent of the property's value to ease financial burdens. The scheme is intended to stimulate demand for new housing and support the construction sector.

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: PV Sindhu played twice on Saturday, with her third-round match finishing after midnight. She was back on court on Sunday afternoon for her quarterfinal against China's Chen Yufei, which she lost.

description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has voiced significant concerns regarding the proposed third runway at Heathrow Airport. He pointed out the necessity of addressing the long-standing worries of local residents. The expansion's timeline could stretch by four years, with operations potentially starting in 2039. Heathrow's struggle with capacity issues sharply contrasts with other major European airports, fueling an ongoing debate centered on community impact and infrastructure demands.
title: Heathrow expansion faces fresh hurdle as UK PM withholds third runway backing

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: As South Korea's KF-21 program progresses towards operational capability, India's AMCA program is still finalizing construction partners. The KF-21 has completed extensive testing and received certification, with production already underway. In contrast, India's bid process for an AMCA partner has faced multiple delays, slowing prototype development. The Indian Air Force currently operates below its authorized fighter strength, increasing operational challenges.

description: Kapil Sibal has raised concerns over the Election Commission's decision-making under Gyanesh Kumar during a ten-month period. His allegations include that decisions were made unilaterally, bypassing other commissioners and statutory protocols. Sibal has called for an investigation into the electoral rolls and recent elections conducted in Bihar and West Bengal. In response, the Election Commission acknowledged concerns and proposed several corrective measures to address them.

description: In a thrilling finish, Harita Bhadra grabbed a bronze in the women’s 200m race, recording 23.20 seconds. Just 0.01 seconds later, Japan’s Abigeirufuka Ido crossed the line. Gold went to Indonesia's Shanti Pereira and silver to China's Yujie Chen. With nine athletics medals amassed at the Aichi-Nagoya Games, India’s team is set to pursue more victories as the competition continues to heat up.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A rare pyramid-shaped tomb has been uncovered at Bir Al-Shaghala in Egypt's Dakhla Oasis and dates back to the Roman period. The tomb, built from mud brick, combines Egyptian and Roman architectural styles and includes inscriptions. Among the findings is a Greek funerary poem dedicated to a man named Psychtis, indicating cultural exchanges. Archaeologists also discovered artifacts related to funerary rituals, including an offering table and a bronze coin.

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, at only 15, has quickly become a rising star in Indian cricket. With exceptional skills and standout performances, he has captured the interest of cricket enthusiasts on a global scale. Dhruv Jurel, who competes alongside him, acknowledges the singular nature of Sooryavanshi's abilities. Although Jurel has found success in recent games, he believes comparisons to Sooryavanshi are unwarranted, as the young talent's impact resonates profoundly in the sport.
title: ‘No jealousy’: Jurel reveals what Sooryavanshi does others ‘can’t even dream of’

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN
description: Vehaan Subramanian, an 18-year-old from Dubai, created a water treatment plant in Uttar Pradesh. The project, named ARUNA, treats arsenic-contaminated groundwater for local communities. Funding was primarily sourced from his personal savings and a reading club he managed. Residents were trained to operate and maintain the facility for sustainable access to clean water. This initiative exemplifies the collaborative efforts between local government and citizens addressing critical water quality issues.
title: 'Giving back to my country': Dubai teen uses birthday savings to build solar plant in UP

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Chadwick Boseman’s widow Taylor Simone Ledward has pushed back against his brothers’ lawsuit over the late actor’s estate. Her legal response says she distributed the required assets and paid $150,000 to Derrick and Kevin from SAG-AFTRA residuals. Ledward’s attorney called the brothers’ case a “public-relations stunt” and denied claims of estate mismanagement.
title: Chadwick Boseman's widow calls brothers' $3.4M estate lawsuit a PR stunt

description: A 13-year-old girl at a residential school was allegedly raped by the principal and three others. School authorities did not inform the police and attempted to suppress the incident.
title: Principal rapes 13-year-old in Gujarat; FIR filed
